title: カラオケでパワーアップ！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio has dragged me to a karaoke booth.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I hope you're ready for this, because my super special concert is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Comin' in! This is the goddess of harvest Golshi herself, bringing a gift of sweet nectar to you lowly peasants!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh, the hell is that?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um… These don't look safe for consumption. Just look at those weird colors.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! Are you telling me you will not partake of my handcrafted libation, mixed with love and chaos?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey! Stop looking at the drinks and pay attention to me! I'm singing here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff! You lot dare refuse my kindness? This calls for punishment!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Next up to pitch, it's the ultimate Golshi! She takes the juice in hand… She readies to throw… And there it goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I shout and dive in front of Tokai Teio, just managing to cover her. A moment later, the juice floods my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh! Oh no, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really?! Wow, what a relief!
choice_data_list: There's no time to lose! We need to start training at once!
There's no time to lose! We need to start training at once!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll start with 300 chants of "Umapyoi," 300 scales, 300 rounds of tambourine practice, and run-throughs of the entire tracklist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, it's dancing while singing. And of course we need to do weight training. Okay! Let's start off with 300 crunches and―

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Trainer, go back to normaaal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't really remember what happened. However, I feel like we had a very productive day filled with training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's actually… good?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It is, it is! The color is weird but it's super sweet and I feel like I'm bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: AHAHAHA! I think I'm on the edge of genius!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Feast your eyes on this! ♪ WHEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, Teio's really spinning! Actually, she's spinning a little too fast… I'm getting… dizzy…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're going waaay too fast…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Are you not entertained?! Ha, ha, ha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even for Teio, this is a whole new level of hyperactive. I'm a little worried for her wellbeing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her dancing seems remarkably improved. A part of me hopes she can hold on to this feeling.
